Title: Next.js: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when SVG files are used
Description: A memory-related vulnerability has been discovered in an upstream library used for Image Optimization can lead to possible remote code execution (RCE) when Next.js runs on glibc-based Linux.
AffectedVersions: All versions starting from 10.0.0 before 15.5.28, all versions starting from 16.0.0 before 16.4.1
NotImpacted: All versions before 10.0.0, all versions starting from 15.5.28 before 16.0.0, all versions starting from 16.4.1
